basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Biomedical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) needs one Research Associate for a project funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation, Science and Engineering Research Board. The pay is Rs.58,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27%, and the project runs up to 17.03.2029. You need a Ph.D in Biomedical/Biotechnology/related subjects, at least 2 published papers in Scopus journals, and experience in molecular biology and in-vivo work. Only Indian nationals may apply. Send the filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 by email to [email protected] by 17 November 2026, 5.0

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec) of IIT Delhi.
Fill the form with complete information on your educational qualifications, showing percentage of marks/division.
Give details of your work experience and the Advertisement Number (IITD/IRD/314/2026) in the form.
Email the filled form to Prof. Neetu Singh at [email protected], with the advertisement number in the subject line.
Send it so that it is submitted by 17 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.
For any clarification on eligibility, contact Prof. Neetu Singh at [email protected].
important_instructions: Only Indian nationals may apply. Meeting the advertised qualification does not guarantee an interview call, since higher short-listing criteria may be fixed. Updates on short-listing and interview details will appear at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted.

Anusandhan National Research Foundation, Science and Engineering Research Board
Renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project (up to 17.03.2029), whichever is earlier
IIT Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. The essential qualification for the Research Associate post is: Ph.D in Biomedical/Biotechnology/related subjects At least 2 published papers in Scopus journals Experience in molecular biology and in-vivo work A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate gets a consolidated pay of Rs.58,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27%. The appointment is on a contractual basis, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The project duration is up to 17.03.2029. If a retired/superannuated government employee is selected, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Research Associate
content_sections.text: For any clarification on eligibility, contact Prof. Neetu Singh at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing eligible candidates from those satisfying the advertised qualification and the requirement of the project post. The names of short-listed candidates will be displayed at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for the online interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Research Associate post under Advertisement No. IITD/IRD/314/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Completed applications must be sent by email by 17 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Delhi Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D in Biomedical/Biotechnology/related subjects, at least 2 published papers in Scopus journals, and experience in molecular biology and in-vivo work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Delhi Research Associate?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs.58,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA @27% is paid in addition to the consolidated pay of Rs.58,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec, fill it and email it to Prof. Neetu Singh at [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write the advertisement number, IITD/IRD/314/2026, in the subject line of the email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are short-listed, possibly on higher criteria fixed by IIT Delhi, and only short-listed candidates are called for an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is contractual, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project (up to 17.03.2029), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, a 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.
